permissions.name: workbuddy-bridge.net.loopback
permissions.reason: Listen on 127.0.0.1 only, so DSH's llm-pi-ai provider can reach the local bridge; nothing binds a public interface.

permissions.name: workbuddy-bridge.net.upstream
permissions.reason: Forward chat and model-list requests to the WorkBuddy gateway (copilot.tencent.com).

permissions.name: workbuddy-bridge.fs.read
permissions.reason: Read the local WorkBuddy client's encrypted login state to obtain the account token.

permissions.name: workbuddy-bridge.process.spawn
permissions.reason: Reuse the WorkBuddy Electron binary in node mode to derive the local at-rest key used to decrypt the login state.

x-display.title: WorkBuddy Bridge
x-display.description: Use the models in your local WorkBuddy account as DSH chat models.
